messages:
alyssa: Hi @jordan, quick Q — I need to delay my secondary caregiver leave start by two weeks because the daycare start got pushed. Current start is 2026-06-08, can I move to 2026-06-22? LR-ID LR-2026-452. I already uploaded the initial paperwork.

jordan (People Ops): hey alyssa — thanks for flagging. We can usually shift start dates but need a signed amendment. Did you file FMLA or partial leave docs? If FMLA yes we'll need a 30-day notice waiver signed, otherwise please fill the amendment here: /hr/forms/parental_leave_amendment.pdf

alyssa: Not FMLA — it's the company top-up for secondary caregivers for 8 weeks. I can sign amendment now. Do we need to notify payroll cutoff for pro-rating?

payroll-bot: Hi! If the amendment is approved before payroll cutoff (2026-05-30), the top-up will be pro-rated from the new start date. Otherwise the top-up will apply from the original start and Payroll will run a manual adjustment. Reply with 'approve' when People Ops confirms.

jordan (People Ops): @linda can you confirm team coverage for the new dates? Also tagging @michael since he volunteered earlier to help with oncall.

linda (Eng Manager): I can provide overlap for the first week. @michael are you still able to take oncall for 2026-06-22 → 2026-07-05? If not we can rotate shifts.

michael: Yep I can take 06/22–07/05 oncall. Happy to swap a few pager shifts. :thumbsup:

jordan (People Ops): Great — I'll draft the amendment and attach to LR-2026-452. Alyssa pls sign the amendment at: https://redwood.hr/leave-amendments/LR-2026-452.pdf (simple e-sign).

alyssa: Signed. Just completed e-sign.

jordan (People Ops): Received, thanks. payroll-bot, please queue pro-rated top-up starting 2026-06-22 and mark the amendment id AM-452 in the record. Alyssa we'll email the formal confirmation and an updated benefits calendar by EOD.

payroll-bot: queued — action id: PAY-98321. Manual adjustment will not be necessary since amendment was within cutoff. You will get a confirmation email when processed.

alyssa: Thank you!! Appreciate the quick help. :smile:

linda (Eng Manager): We'll do a short runbook handoff next week. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with @michael and @alyssa to walk through current oncall runbook, outstanding PRs, and the handover checklist.
